story.text: One command: `pnpm host` — the site, both apps, and the engine on one origin at `localhost:1337`.

Open [/supervisor/](/supervisor/) as the regulator and [/agent/](/agent/) as the agent (autonomous mode is on — it approaches and answers by itself). The dashboard's walkthrough sidebar ticks the ten demo beats off from engine state as you go.
Act I takes about three minutes; Act II about ninety seconds. The click-by-click script is `docs/demo-runbook.md` in the repository.
